name: pilot
when: Judging a pilot query one image at a time.

steps.title: A pilot query: one image at a time
steps.text: Pilot queries are not grouped: judge every image on its own. These judgments show how well grouping would work for the rest of the study, so take your time.

steps.title: Collapse judged
steps.text: Hides the images once all of them are judged; switch it off to see them again.
